data.name: Ihsanaat
data.gender_notes: Ihsanaat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ihsanaat is derived from the Arabic root h-s-n, which means 'to make a thing beautiful or to grant a favor'. The name Ihsanaat signifies the bestowal of grace, mercy, and benevolence. The name Ihsanaat carries the meaning “Grace, Mercy, Kindness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ihsanaat usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, mercy, kindness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ihsanaat is a reminder of the divine blessings and mercy that we receive from Allah, and a call to extend the same grace and kindness to others.
data.etymology: Ihsanaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace, Mercy, Kindness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ihsanaat total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

It reminds us of the importance of compassion towards others and treating them with grace and favor. The name also signifies the Islamic concept of sadaqah, or charitable giving, which is seen as an essential practice for purifying one's soul and earning divine favor.
data.spiritual_significance: Ihsanaat holds deep spiritual significance for Muslims as it denotes the presence and action of God's mercy and grace in one's life. The name calls upon us to strive towards excellence in all aspects of our lives and to provide services and favor to others selflessly, as an expression of gratitude and love for God's abundant blessings upon us. Ihsanaat also reminds us of the importance of striving towards self-improvement and purification, as we seek to live in accordance with God's will and please Him through our actions. Ultimately, the name Ihsanaat calls upon us to be compassionate and merciful towards all creation, and to extend God's grace and favor to all those around us, thereby fulfilling our role as God's vicegerents on earth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ihsanaat represents acts of kindness, goodness, and benevolence. It is a constant reminder for Muslims to strive for excellence in their deeds and to spread positivity in their actions towards others. This name is a call to embody the beautiful characteristics of compassion and generosity, reflecting the grace of Allah in our lives.
